performance_case.causal_mechanism: A currently runnable Local Python and dual-PowerShell validation surface prevents an evidence-ready mechanism task from failing only because the execution node cannot start its required deterministic tools.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch proves only current zero-write Local execution readiness, exact task/dispatch/intent validation and V3R1 active-chain verification. It proves no market evidence, prediction, causal alpha, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS, deployment or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future path-risk effect requires a separately preregistered matched-capital experiment over untouched evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One bounded non-counting integrity probe consumes at most fifteen minutes but prevents wasting a later scarce forward-evidence event on an execution environment that previously denied Python startup.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL is unchanged. The capability value is lower time-to-evidence and fewer failed Local dispatches once a countable mechanism or evaluator task becomes evidence-ready.
